page.overview:
Who is Gtuhanai?

Gtuhanai the Insatiable is a fictional entity created by author J. B. Lee for his 1999 short story "Forces of Change."

Manifesting as a whirling conglomeration of helical metal structures, Gtuhanai is capable of absorbing any metals in its vicinity into its body, in turn increasing its own mass and power. What the upper limits to this ability are remain unknown, but are implied to perhaps be limitless. (: "Forces of Change")

According to the Necronomicon, Gtuhanai is worshipped by a species of metal beings known as the Aartna, which inhabit the region of space around the Pleiades star cluster. (: "Forces of Change")

Gtuhanai is the "brother" of Cthulhu and the "son" of Yog-Sothoth; it has also been described as being somewhat similar to Glaaki, although whether any "familial" relationship exists between the two entities is unknown. It was first summoned to Earth by the sorcerer Mezamalek (perhaps the same being as Zon Mezzamalech of Hyperborea) who used its power on his enemies, obliterating all who stood against him before the entity turned on Mezamalek and consumed him. (: "Forces of Change")
